lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mg14Ti2Sn2 (Mg7TiSn) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 18 atoms in the unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only analysis shows Mg centers predominantly with 12 geometric neighbors in close-packed-like local arrangements, while Ti and Sn each have 16 neighbors. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 18 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and face-sharing between 12-vertex Mg polyhedra, and corner- and edge-sharing between 12-vertex Mg and 16-vertex Ti or Sn polyhedra.
